hold_reason: review: NVIDIA: Hindi meaning 'यह Limitation Act में time से अधिकार प्राप्ति है' is inaccurate; the Limitation Act deals with limitation periods for filing suits, not acquisition of rights by time (which is positive prescription from common law, not typically 'in Limitation Act').
